security_audit.summary: The static external-command and network alerts are mostly Markdown and example-code false positives, and no prompt injection was found. The skill does run a local Playwright workflow and may handle credentials, so the main concerns are temporary password storage and sensitive authenticated screenshots saved on disk.

remediation.issue: Temporary password storage in generated scripts
remediation.suggestion: Avoid writing passwords into scripts. Prefer manual login, browser storage state, or short-lived environment variables that are cleared immediately.
Warn users to use demo accounts, seed data, or redaction before capturing authenticated pages.

remediation.issue: Local command execution during screenshot generation
remediation.suggestion: Ask before running setup or capture commands, and keep generated scripts scoped to the chosen app URL and screenshots directory.

content.value_statement: Teams need polished screenshots that show real product workflows. This skill uses Playwright to plan, capture, and verify marketing-ready web app images.
actual_capabilities: Plans screenshot sets for launches, social posts, landing pages, and documentation.
Inspects app documentation, routes, and components to identify useful pages.
Creates a local screenshots directory for generated image files.
Generates a Playwright script with a 1440 by 900 viewport and 2x scale.
Supports optional login flows with common email and password selectors.
Verifies saved screenshot files and reports expected image dimensions.
limitations: Requires Playwright and a reachable local or hosted web app.
Login automation may fail on unusual or multi-factor authentication forms.
Screenshots can contain private data when captured from authenticated pages.
Does not upload, edit, crop, or retouch images after capture.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Images
use_cases.description: Capture consistent product screenshots for Product Hunt, social announcements, or landing page sections.

use_cases.title: Document User Workflows
use_cases.description: Create clean screenshots of important screens for guides, onboarding pages, and help center articles.

use_cases.title: Review Visual States
use_cases.description: Capture dashboards, forms, modals, dark mode, and full pages for product review.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Public Pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small public screenshot set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate three public screenshots of my app at http://localhost:3000 for a landing page. Use retina quality and summarize the files created.

prompt_templates.title: Create Launch Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best product features in this app and create five Product Hunt screenshots. Ask me to confirm the feature list before capture.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Authenticated Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Documentation request for pages behind login.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create screenshots for the onboarding workflow after login. Use a demo account, avoid private data, and verify each output image.

prompt_templates.title: Build Screenshot Suite
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a comprehensive capture plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect routes, docs, and key components, then build a full screenshot suite with focused elements, full pages, modals, and dark mode variants.

output_examples.input: Capture five Product Hunt screenshots for a public SaaS app.
output: Planned five feature-focused captures from the discovered routes.
Saved retina screenshots with ordered, descriptive filenames.
Reported each file path, image size, and expected resolution.

output_examples.input: Create documentation images for an authenticated dashboard.
output: Asked for the login page and demo credentials before capture.
Captured dashboard, settings, and modal states after login.
Recommended reviewing images for private data before publishing.

output_examples.output: The skill lists generated image files, confirms dimensions when tools are available, and summarizes any capture issues.

best_practices: Use demo data or seed data before capturing marketing screenshots.
Confirm the feature list and page states before running the Playwright script.
Review every authenticated screenshot for private data before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not capture production accounts that contain customer or payment data.
Do not run generated scripts against an unknown URL.
Do not skip verification when screenshots are intended for public use.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates local PNG screenshots of web app pages using Playwright and a high-resolution browser context.

faq.question: Does it need Playwright installed?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill checks for Playwright and tells the user how to install it if it is missing.

faq.question: Can it capture pages behind login?
faq.answer: Yes, it can use provided credentials with common login form selectors. Use demo accounts when possible.

faq.question: Does it upload screenshots anywhere?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow saves screenshots to a local screenshots directory.

faq.question: What resolution does it target?
faq.answer: The template uses a 1440 by 900 viewport with a 2x device scale factor for retina output.

faq.question: Can it capture modals or dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for clicking UI states, focused elements, full pages, and dark mode.
